objective: Preallocate foreign-key schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate foreign-key schema keys
tasks.result: Foreign-key schema lookup now uses an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in foreign-key load_table_schema() key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, referenced-table schema loads, child and parent FK checks, and SQL constraint behavior are unchanged.
Cargo printed global cache last-use warnings about database or disk being full; commands exited successfully and tests passed.
